sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Clicking on the ball only changed the timer bar (2 pixels at the bottom right: W→B). So the timer is decreasing from the right side. The ball didn't move.
In other words, the ball isn't the player. The player piece must be the yellow block, and it's currently in the HUD. In level 1, the purple block in the HUD was a mirror of the block on the board. This time, the yellow block in the HUD has no counterpart on the board. Maybe the piece spawns on the board when you click somewhere, or maybe the piece is the ball, and the "dotted line" is where the ball will roll when you press ACTION7 (launch)!
New hypothesis: This game is about launching the ball. In level 1, the ball was fixed... no wait, in level 1 the ball was in the top right, and the block was moving. Hmm.
Let me look at the dots again: (37,18), (37,41), (40,37), (41,16), (54,49), (55,14), (56,47), (57,16).
The ball is at (23-31, 29-39), center (27,34).
Left-side dots: (37,18), (41,16), (55,14), (57,16).
Right-side dots: (37,41), (40,37), (54,49), (56,47).
Hmm, wait: (40,37) — is this on the right side? Column 37 > center 34, so right side.
Left-side line: (37,18), (41,16): slope (16-18)/(41-37) = -0.5. Continue: (45,15), (49,14), (53,13)... but (55,14) and (57,16) don't fit.
Right-side line: (37,41), (40,37): slope (37-41)/(40-37) = -4/3. Continue: (43,33)... but (54,49), (56,47) are in the opposite direction (going down-right).
So maybe there are 4 lines? Like an X shape? Or the dots are endpoints of 2 "V" shapes?
Left: (37,18)→(41,16)→...→(55,14)→(57,16)? That's a V with the bottom at (55,14).
Right: (37,41)→(40,37)→...→(56,47)→(54,49)? That's also a V.
So each side is a V (valley) shape: the left V descends from (37,18) to (55,14), then rises to (57,16). The right V descends from (37,41) to (56,47)?? Wait, (56,47) and (54,49): descending from (37,41) to (40,37)?? That's going down-left. Hmm, (37,41)→(40,37): row +3, column -4. Then (54,49)→(56,47): row +2, column -2.
Ugh. Let me think of it this way: the right V: (37,41) descends down-right to (54,49), (56,47)?? (56,47) is up-left of (54,49).
Maybe the dots are: left line A: (37,18), (41,16) [going down-left], left line B: (55,14), (57,16) [going down-right]. These two lines meet around (53,15)? So the left V: descends from (37,18) to about (53,15), then rises... no wait, (57,16) is below (55,14).
I think the dots are sparse samples of two V-shaped (or checkmark-shaped) lines:
Left check: from (37,18) down-left to (55,14)?? That's only 2 columns left over 18 rows. Then from (55,14) down-right to (57,16).
Right check: from (37,41) down-left to (40,37)?? Then from (40,37) down-right to (54,49), (56,47)?? (56,47) breaks that.
I'm overthinking the geometry. The dots might just be scattered "collectible stars" (like the white cross in level 1). In level 1 there was 1 cross. Here there are 8 stars. The goal might be to collect all the stars and then reach the ball? But what's the player?
The 4 small 2x2 blocks in the HUD (S, M, p, Y) might be 4 different "pieces" — like a palette. The 4x4 yellow block in the HUD is the currently selected piece. Maybe you need to click on the board to place the yellow block, and then move it with clicks?
Let me try clicking on an empty board cell, e.g., (50,32), to see if the yellow block gets placed there.
